authoring.note: Van Baerlestraat 22-30 (even), between the Alexander Boersstraat and the Jan Luijkenstraat: the 1930 corner block 28-30 (tiled hip roof, a steep centre gable, a stone shop portal), 26 (1909, a tall bell gable, Essentiel Antwerp) and 22-24 (1909, a mansard pair over Oogappel and Reflections).
